statusLine.command: input=$(cat); session_id=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); session='default'; if [ -n "$session_id" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.claude/session-names/$session_id" ]; then session=$(cat "$HOME/.claude/session-names/$session_id"); fi; cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); cwd_display="${cwd/#$HOME/~}"; cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null || true; git_info=''; if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$(git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ] && dirty='*' || dirty=''; git_info=$(printf "\033[32m%s%s\033[0m " "$branch" "$dirty"); fi; printf "\033[35m[%s]\033[0m %s\033[34m%s\033[0m" "$session" "$git_info" "$cwd_display"
